newsitem.title: SPAIN: RESEARCH ALERT - Mapfre results upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mapfre results upgraded.

text.p: BBV Interactivos, the broking arm of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, has upgraded its results forecast for insurance group Corporacion Mapfre, maintaining its buy recommendation for the shares, a research note dated July 1997 said on Monday.

The brokerage has upgraded its target price to 9,185 from around 8,800 pesetas. The revision is due to expectations that the group will benefit from Latin American growth medium and long term, being well-established in the region and the leader of the Spanish-speaking market.

Interactivos also upgraded its results forecast for the life branch of the same group, Mapfre Vida, maintaining its accumulate recommendation. Its target price is now 10,500 pesetas versus around 10,300 pesetas.
Interactivos said its 1997 results forecast for Corporacion Mapfre is for net profit of 10.71 billion pesetas, while Mapfre Vida is forecast to post net earnings of 6.35 billion pesetas.
